After you click Apply Now and complete your application, you'll be invited to create a profile, which will let you see your application status and any communications. If you already have a profile with us, you can log in to check status. 
 
 Need Help? 
 
 If you have a disability and need assistance with the application, you can request a reasonable accommodation. Send an email to Accessibility (accommodation requests only; other inquiries won't receive a response). 
 
 Regular or Temporary: 
Regular 
 Language Fluency:  English (Required)
 
 Work Shift: 
1st shift (United States of America) 
 
 Please review the following job description: 
 
Independently leads the design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, and support of complex Salesforce solutions supporting Consumer Servicing, Contact Center, and Digital Engagement platforms. This role serves as a senior technical contributor and partner across Product, Operations, Architecture, AWS, Integration, and Delivery teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality solutions within the Salesforce ecosystem.
The ideal candidate brings deep Salesforce platform expertise, strong knowledge of Financial Services Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Service Cloud, and experience working within complex, highly integrated enterprise environments. While this is not a dedicated developer role, the individual must possess sufficient hands-on technical knowledge to support solution design, code reviews, troubleshooting, and development team oversight. 
 
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 
 Lead the design, implementation, and support of Salesforce solutions utilizing Financial Services Cloud, Service Cloud, and Sales Cloud capabilities. Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Developers, QA, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions. Provide technical leadership for enhancements supporting contact center and servicing platforms, including Salesforce-based agent experiences. Collaborate with onshore and offshore delivery teams to ensure consistent execution, quality standards, and successful delivery of roadmap initiatives. Support and guide solution design activities involving integrations with Enterprise APIs, MuleSoft, AWS services, and other enterprise platforms. Participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, code reviews, and production support activities. Troubleshoot complex production issues and coordinate resolution efforts across Salesforce, integration, infrastructure, and vendor teams. Support Agile delivery processes, including PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release management. Partner closely with dependent technology teams to identify risks, manage dependencies, and ensure successful end-to-end delivery. Participate in deployment planning and release execution utilizing modern DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and source control management processes. Drive adoption of Salesforce best practices, governance standards, security requirements, and regulatory controls. Mentor junior team members and provide technical guidance across the Salesforce delivery organization.
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
 5-7+ years of Salesforce platform experience.
 Strong experience with: Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
 Salesforce Service Cloud
 Salesforce Sales Cloud
 
 Working knowledge of Apex, Lightning Components/LWC, SOQL, APIs, and Salesforce platform architecture.
 Experience supporting large-scale Salesforce implementations in enterprise environments.
 Experience partnering with offshore development teams and managing work across distributed delivery models.
 Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and software delivery lifecycle processes.
 Experience supporting integrations utilizing MuleSoft, Enterprise APIs, and REST/SOAP-based services.
 Knowledge of Salesforce DevOps processes, including: Git and source control management
 CI/CD pipelines
 Deployment and release management
 Environment strategy and governance
 
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Salesforce certifications such as: Salesforce Administrator
 Platform App Builder
 Platform Developer I
 Service Cloud Consultant
 Financial Services Cloud Accreditation
 
 Experience with Contact Center technologies, including: Service Cloud Voice (SCV)
 Salesforce Contact Center / SCC-AC
 Digital Engagement
 CTI integrations
 IVR technologies
 
 Experience partnering with AWS teams and a working knowledge of AWS-based contact center architectures and integrations.
 Knowledge of consumer banking, servicing, and contact center operations.
 Experience supporting Wealth, Premier, Mortgage, Scheduler, or related servicing platforms.
 
 General Description of Available Benefits for Eligible Employees of Truist Financial Corporation: All regular teammates (not temporary or contingent workers) working 20 hours or more per week are eligible for benefits, though eligibility for specific benefits may be determined by the division of Truist offering the position. Truist offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, accidental death and dismemberment, tax-preferred savings accounts, and a 401k plan to teammates. Teammates also receive no less than 10 days of vacation (prorated based on date of hire and by full-time or part-time status) during their first year of employment, along with 10 sick days (also prorated), and paid holidays. For more details on Truist’s generous benefit plans, please visit our Benefits site . Depending on the position and division, this job may also be eligible for Truist’s defined benefit pension plan, restricted stock units, and/or a deferred compensation plan. As you advance through the hiring process, you will also learn more about the specific benefits available for any non-temporary position for which you apply, based on full-time or part-time status, position, and division of work.
